metadata.case_name: WONG MIU KWAN v. FPDSAVILLS PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: security guard (Professional Security Services Ltd since 23 November 2002)

injuries.description: back injury with continuous back pain
source: she sustained a back injury with continuous back pain.

After examining the plaintiff, Dr Lau commented that she suffered left wrist tenderness and back and right pelvic tenderness with decreased range of movement of the lumbosacral spine as a result of her accident on 2 November 2000.

In his opinion, the MRI of her lumber spine taken in September 2001 had showed degenerative changes in her lumbosacral spine. These degenerative changes should have existed before the accident on 2 November 2000.

He further stated that the plaintiff has had a long period of conservative treatment of her back which should have improved but that she is still left with significant residual pain over her low back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: decreased range of movement of the lumbosacral spine

treatments_received: long period of conservative treatment of her back
